external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A person who uses the loyalty programme, collects points, spends them on gift cards, and connects partner apps.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application run by another company on its own server.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: A browser used by a member to sign in and approve consent.
external_entities.source_excerpt: signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application used by members to sign in, call the rewards API, and disconnect partner apps.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The authorization server that signs members in, issues tokens and authorization codes, presents consent, and signs access tokens.
processes.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API that reads and writes the points ledger and processes point redemption requests.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Ledger holding every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Store containing every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store

data_flows.name: use app
data_flows.description: Member uses the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Mobile app signs a member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: Mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

data_flows.name: token requests
data_flows.description: Partner app sends token requests containing its client secret.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.data_description: Client ID, client secret, and token requests

data_flows.name: sign-in page
data_flows.description: Browser accesses the authorization server sign-in page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

data_flows.name: return code
data_flows.description: Browser returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.notes: Authorization code validity is ten minutes.

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: Partner app calls the rewards API to show a member's points.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a meal-planning service that shows a member's points

data_flows.name: store identity data
data_flows.description: Authorization server stores and accesses identity and authorization data.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database
data_flows.data_description: Accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: delete refresh token
data_flows.description: Mobile app causes a disconnected partner app's refresh token to be deleted from the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which deletes that app's refresh token from the identity database

data_flows.name: update ledger
data_flows.description: Rewards API reads and writes the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
data_flows.notes: Redeeming points needs a valid access token carrying the redeem scope.

data_flows.name: write request logs
data_flows.description: Rewards API writes every received request, including headers, to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store

data_flows.name: obtain token
data_flows.description: Support console takes access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: Support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.
data_flows.notes: Member refresh tokens remain in the database.

data_flows.name: download key
data_flows.description: Rewards API downloads the authorization server's public key when it starts.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API checks the signature with a public key it downloads when it starts.

trust_boundaries.name: own cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account where the platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: member phone
trust_boundaries.description: The member's phone hosting the mobile app and its refresh token.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

trust_boundaries.name: partner server
trust_boundaries.description: Servers owned and operated by companies running partner apps.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is reachable from the internet.
assumptions.basis: It is served on a public hostname.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is reachable from the internet.
assumptions.basis: It is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.
It contains member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
It contains every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: API log store contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: It contains every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
